narrative: High-quality liquid assets average EUR 1,018M against EUR 389M of net outflows — an LCR of 261.4% at June 2026, down from 298.8% at year-end as deposits were deployed into loans. NSFR is 159.4% and the loan-to-deposit ratio about 55%. Funding is not the constraint; the cost of carrying surplus cash is.
